The refinements are in. Reload **http://maker:4001/app.html**:

> 1. **Public warning before archiving:** press **"Create Internet Archive copy"** — it now first warns *"This creates a public copy on archive.org, visible to anyone. Continue?"* with **Create public copy** / **Cancel**. Only on confirming does it proceed. The local copy has no such warning, since it's private to you.
> 2. **Capture failure with a reason:** in the save box add `https://example.com/login`, save it, then press **"Save a local copy"** on it — it fails clearly with *"Couldn't save a copy — the page requires signing in"* and offers **Try again**; the bookmark itself is untouched. (`https://no-such-site.example` fails with "couldn't be reached.")
> 3. **Auto-capture setting:** open **⚙ Settings**, tick **"Automatically save a local copy when I save a bookmark,"** Save. Now save a fresh normal link — it captures a local copy on its own. Manual **Save a local copy** / **Update** stay available per bookmark either way.

The wording for a normal page now says the copy is **self-contained** (opens offline); a **PDF stores the PDF itself**.

Does this settle Block E — both copy types with the public archive clearly flagged, optional auto-capture, and graceful failure that never harms the bookmark?
